reviews.title: Degrading
reviews.text: It used to be a good app but now everything just went wrong. solat timings not updated, wrong islamic calendar, cant update location anymore, even clicking on troubleshooting function leads to nowhere. not reliable and cant be trusted. the solat timings are really misleading, and could cause one to accidentally perform prayer at the wrong time

reviews.title: Date
reviews.text: Today was 1 rabiulawwal in Malaysia, But this apps wrote 30 safar. Not updated, wrong dates. Not recommended
